opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: Generally £1,500-£5,000; will only exceptionally exceed £6,000. Travel up to £2,000 (≤13 days) or £2,500 (14+ days) per person; PhD fieldwork visits up to £5,000; Japan office up to ¥300,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects. UK-originating projects apply to the UK office; Japan-originating to the Japan office. Previous recipients may apply for new projects.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK-Japan projects that might otherwise not be possible, bringing people in the UK and Japan together to deepen mutual understanding, exchange ideas/expertise, or develop lasting collaboration. Supports festivals, workshops, performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language/cultural studies, and academic research.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

deadlines.raw: 1 December (annual, for a decision in March of the following year)

amount.raw: Up to £10,000 per year; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, total limit £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record, but consideration also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Project must involve partners in both the UK and Japan. Preference given to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration; early-career applications particularly welcomed. Apply to the UK office regardless of location.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses or to contribute to other costs including conference and publication costs.
